So first a quick meta-question:

I have several rules questions regarding various aspects of the game, non of which seem to be addressed in the FAQ.  Should I put them all in one thread, so as to avoid flooding the forum with my topics, or in separate threads, so as to keep each thread focused on a particular issue?

 

edit: the first several answers to this post suggested one post per topic, so I've moved the other questions to their own threads.
